# CANDIDATE: VWAP_DEVIATION_MEAN_REVERSION

**Filed:** 2026-09-06  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price deviates more than 1σ from the 20‑period VWAP and shows exhaustion (wick > 2× body), it tends to snap back to VWAP. This mean‑reversion edge captures moves opposite to the prevailing short‑term trend, complementary to existing VWAP‑continuation strategies.

## Mechanism

Compute 20‑period VWAP and its 1‑σ band using ATR(20) as σ. If price closes above the upper band AND the bar’s upper wick > 2× body length, enter short at the close; if price closes below the lower band AND lower wick > 2× body length, enter long at the close. Exit: stop at the opposite VWAP band plus 0.5×ATR (shorts: upper band+0.5×ATR; longs: lower band-0.5×ATR); target is re‑touching the VWAP line (0R) then let runner trail using a 15% off high‑water‑mark after 1R profit. Avoid first/last 30 min and VIX outside 12‑22.
